_readme: Memberships people belong to, with perks and credits from each provider's own pages. Same format as card_benefits.json (kind = membership). Run `npm run seed:build` after editing.
merchant_match on a perk means the membership includes that service at no extra cost; PerkScan uses it to spot subscriptions you may be paying for twice.

benefits.terms_summary: Free Grubhub+: $0 delivery fees on eligible orders and lower service fees. Link it in your Grubhub account.
